milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The yellow_bed is at spawn-relative (3, 1, 3) on the south side of the bedroom. Player must navigate into the bedroom and face the bed. max_distance=4 ensures the player is inside the room, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking toward the bed rather than elsewhere.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted_poppy is at spawn-relative (3, 2, 7) on the north windowsill, 4 blocks from the bed. max_distance=3 creates a tight trigger zone that won't overlap with the bed milestone (target at Z=3), ensuring intentional navigation to the far side of the room.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted_blue_orchid is at spawn-relative (7, 2, 3) on the east-side shelf. max_distance=3 differentiates this from the barrel behind the half-wall at Z=5. The facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the orchid specifically, not the barrel on the other side of the wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The barrel is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 5), hidden behind the half-wall at (7, 1-2, 4). Player must walk around the half-wall to face the barrel from the Z=5+ side. max_distance=3 and facing_tolerance=60 toward Z=5 ensure the player has navigated around the wall rather than just standing near the orchid.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The scaffolding tower center is at spawn-relative (10, 2, 4) in the outdoor courtyard. max_distance=5 allows detection from a reasonable outdoor viewing distance while still requiring the player to exit the bedroom and approach the courtyard area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown_banner is at spawn-relative (10, 5, 4), elevated on a support block above the scaffolding. max_distance=6 accounts for the vertical offset (player at Y~1, banner at Y=5, giving ~4 blocks vertical distance). facing_tolerance=75 is wider to accommodate the upward pitch angle needed to look at the elevated banner.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden_pickaxe results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts without any wooden_pickaxe, so having min_count=1 confirms successful crafting. Materials come solely from the barrel (2 sticks + 3 oak_planks), enforcing the barrel→craft dependency.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The nether_wart_block is at spawn-relative (13, 2, 10) embedded in the workshop's east interior wall. max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered the workshop through its door. The distinctive dark red block contrasts with surrounding stone_bricks, making it visually identifiable.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_granite with a wooden_pickaxe or better causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts without any polished_granite, so min_count=1 confirms successful mining. Polished granite is at (12, 1, 8) in the workshop wall and is confirmed mineable with a wooden pickaxe.
